about: Shared allowlist for remote Claude Code login (login-v1): the only authorize URLs hmd will publish to the phone and the only code shape it will type into `claude auth login`. A heimdall-authored stand-in written from hmdapp's docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-remote-cc-login.md sections 3.2 and 4.4 until the app's wave-0 docs/samples/login/allowlist.json lands: vendor that file over this one, then re-pin the checksums in test/companion-cc-login-vectors.test.sh. Every host/path/redirect row is an endpoint constant of the installed Claude Code 2.1.288 (its pn() config object: CLAUDE_AI_AUTHORIZE_URL, CONSOLE_AUTHORIZE_URL, MANUAL_REDIRECT_URL); the legacy row is the pair older builds used.
